title: Designing with shapes
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a crop that preserves the photograph’s subject. An angled edge can frame a single person yet cut into people at the edge of a group.
strategic_value: Voltera can repeat a family of angled and rounded shapes while leaving the people in a photograph legible. The same shape rules can govern both interface elements and large photographic fields.
demonstration: Two crops of the same group photograph are stacked beside a single-person example. The rectangular group crop and angled portrait carry check marks. The angled group crop carries a cross.
practical_value: Inspect the subject near each proposed edge before applying a slant. Where a slant fits, use the stated allowance of 10% of the shape width per angled side.
